translations.web: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
translations.bsb: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, and you are that temple.
translations.kjv: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall ➔ God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.
translations.asv: If any man destroyeth the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, and such are ye.
